name: Chiron Backpack Foundation
description:
Item Type: Light Backpack
Carrying Capacity: 75K µSCU
Core Compatibility: All
 
Engineered with first responders in mind, the Chiron backpack provides an ideal carryall for critical supplies with quick access to the medical essentials that are stored inside.
 
Celebrate the UEE's commitment to building a brighter future with this Foundation Festival special edition. Designed with Guides and other community leaders in mind, it features a teal polyfiber underlayer and matching accents on the carbon plating sections.
